text:
sam-ops: Heads up — AcmeMedia opened a request for a 5x daily token cap increase. Ticket: https://zendesk.example/12345
fraud-bot: ALERT — payment pattern anomaly (card rotated 3x in 24h), geo mismatch. Score: 0.87
mike-support: I triaged. Customer claims sudden campaign spike. Provided app logs but contact email is gmail. No org SSO.
jess-sales: They say it's for a time-limited ad push this week. We've been talking reserved capacity but haven't signed a contract.
nana-product: What's the bar for provisional increases? We need controls: timebox, rollback, and a clear escalation path.
sam-ops: My suggestion: provisional 2x for 48h with mandatory payment verification and auto-revoke if fraud-bot score > 0.6.
devon-eng-security: Can we require billing token verification + IP allowlisting? Also need the customer's recent request samples and usage pattern.
mike-support: Pasting the example request they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_***' -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","input":"launch ad copy..."}'
```
nana-product: Launch criteria for full uplift: sustained legitimate usage for 72h, error rate <1%, no chargebacks or disputed payments, and SSO or org verification within 7 days. Also adding a product backlog ticket for a provisional-quota workflow.
jess-sales: I'll escalate to Legal for expedited MSA. Can we gate final approval to product + sales signoff? :eyes:
mike-support: Adding fraud report & request history to the zendesk ticket and support dashboard: https://support.example/reports/987
devon-eng-security: If we approve, engineering will want an automated rollback playbook and an alert that triggers at anomaly thresholds. I'll draft the runbook.
fraud-bot: MONITOR — high risk persists if new payment methods are added.
sam-ops: TL;DR — provisional 2x for 48h, require payment verification + IP allowlist, manual approval by ana-product + jess-sales, automation rollback by devon. Filed Jira PROJ-2419 to capture backlog work. Assigning follow-ups in the Zendesk ticket.
